question: What was total revenue in 2025?
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: How many orders did we get in March 2026?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01'

question: Revenue by category in 2025
gold: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN sales.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.name

question: Top 3 countries by revenue
gold: SELECT cu.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY cu.country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which region had the most orders last year?
gold: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN sales.regions r ON r.region_id = cu.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: Monthly number of orders in the last 6 months
gold: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date, COUNT(*) FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1

question: Average order value by channel
gold: WITH t AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel) SELECT channel, ROUND(AVG(total), 2) FROM t GROUP BY channel

question: Units sold per category in Q2 2026
gold: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN sales.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c.name

question: Gross profit by region in 2025
gold: SELECT r.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN sales.regions r ON r.region_id = cu.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.name

question: Refund rate by category
gold: SELECT c.name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'refunded') / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 1) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN sales.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Cancellation rate by channel in 2025
gold: SELECT channel, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*), 1) FROM sales.orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY channel

question: How many new customers signed up in 2025?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01' AND signup_date < '2026-01-01'

question: New customers per month this year
gold: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date)::date, COUNT(*) FROM sales.customers WHERE signup_date >= '2026-01-01' AND signup_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1

question: Top 10 customers by revenue in 2025
gold: SELECT cu.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which sales rep had the highest revenue in 2025?
gold: SELECT sr.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.sales_reps sr ON sr.rep_id = o.rep_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY sr.rep_id, sr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Quarterly revenue for Smart Home
gold: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date)::date, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN sales.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.name = 'Smart Home' GROUP BY 1

question: Compare Online and Retail revenue by year
gold: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int, o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.channel IN ('Online', 'Retail') GROUP BY 1, 2

question: Revenue from Enterprise customers in Europe last quarter
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN sales.regions r ON r.region_id = cu.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND cu.segment = 'Enterprise' AND r.name = 'Europe' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01'

question: What share of revenue does each category make up?
gold: SELECT c.name, ROUND(100 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount))) OVER (), 1) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN sales.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.name

question: Best-selling product in Germany in 2025
gold: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND cu.country = 'Germany' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

question: Revenue 2024 vs 2025
gold: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1

question: How many customers placed an order in 2025?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: Average discount by customer segment
gold: SELECT cu.segment, ROUND(100 * AVG(oi.discount), 1) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY cu.segment

question: Daily revenue over the last 14 days
gold: SELECT o.order_date, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date > DATE '2026-09-30' - 14 GROUP BY 1

question: Which month in 2025 had the highest revenue?
gold: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were refunded in 2025?

question: What was the gross margin for laptops in 2026?

question: Number of customers by segment

question: Weekly orders in September 2026
gold: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', order_date)::date, COUNT(*) FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1

question: Revenue by country in Latin America this year
gold: SELECT cu.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN sales.regions r ON r.region_id = cu.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND r.name = 'Latin America' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY cu.country

question: And in 2024?
gold: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many customers bought both a laptop and a monitor in 2025?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN sales.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND c.name IN ('Laptops', 'Monitors') GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) = 2) t

question: What was the median order value in 2025?
gold: SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total))::numeric, 2) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.order_id) t

question: Revenue growth in percent by region from 2024 to 2025
gold: WITH y AS (SELECT r.name AS region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS year, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN sales.regions r ON r.region_id = cu.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT region, ROUND(100 * (SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE year = 2025) / SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE year = 2024) - 1), 1) FROM y GROUP BY region

question: How many customers have placed more than 5 orders?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) t

question: How many customers have never placed an order?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.customers cu WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = cu.customer_id)

question: What's the average number of units per order?
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

question: Total revenue from discontinued products
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.discontinued

question: Revenue from products launched in 2025, by product
gold: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.launched_on >= '2025-01-01' AND p.launched_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.name
